notes: CAVEAT: the page states 'Serial Number styles found for Fedders-Airwell brands are being used here. Although unconfirmed it is believed that all Fedders-Airwell brand units use these styles.' That unconfirmed-belief caveat applies to the style below; it is shipped as this page's own stated content with the caveat on file, following the Airwell/Emerson precedent, not silently. NOTHING is imported from any Fedders page: the shipped style is transcribed from Melcor's own page text alone. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (week = 3rd-4th characters, year = 5th-6th characters, example EW020144126H) — it shares its shape (2 letters + 9 digits + 1 letter) with held page Style 3, so a Style 3 serial would mis-decode under Style 1 with a wrong week/year; same hold as the Airwell/Emerson files. Page Styles 3, 4 and 5 are held for the image pass (month/year letters chart-only). Note: the Koppel file ships page Style 1 despite this collision; the coordinator may wish to reconcile that outlier against the Airwell/Emerson hold.

styles.era: 8-character serials (normalized), 2 digits + letter + 5 digits, year only
styles.notes: Page example shown as '02J-60002' (dash stripped by normalization). Year = 1st & 2nd characters (digits) -> '02' -> 2002. Month = 3rd character letter per chart image FEDDERS-2-Serial-Number.jpg, held for the image pass, so year-only. Pattern is disjoint from all other page styles (Style 4 is 3 letters + 5 digits; Style 5 is 5 digits + 2 letters, 7 characters), so no shape collision.
